implementation: Independent algorithm reimplementation; no novel upstream source vendored
license_evidence: IRG and LPLD lack a tracked LICENSE/COPYING; GitHub license is null and PKG-INFO reports UNKNOWN. Simple-SFOD also has no tracked LICENSE/COPYING. No raw source-copy grant is established; implementations are independent and attributed.

common_protocol.data: Existing image-only target VAL loader; never annotation-dependent empty-image filtering or target GT histograms
common_protocol.sources: Unchanged dataset-specific OrthoNet-50/FPN Oriented R-CNN sources
common_protocol.auxiliary_proposals: first/top-objectness 300 raw teacher RPN proposals per image; unchanged full HPL/final NMS pipeline
common_protocol.features: actual 1024-D pre-fc_cls vectors, original indexed teacher proposals in matched shared geometry
common_protocol.batch_reduction: mean of per-image normalized losses, including zero-loss images; no cross-image graph
common_protocol.selection: final teacher; method-specific update cadence declared below
common_protocol.not_claimed: Published-budget or bit-identical author benchmark reproduction; method-specific differences are recorded below

canonical_mechanisms: Code squared-dot affinities normalized row-L1, not paper softmax adjacency
Shared D->512->512->D GCN and two separate D->D->D contrastive MLPs, train-time-only
Student graph uses Student classifier; Teacher graph uses frozen Teacher classifier with input gradients into GCN
Three unit-weight KL terms include background; teacher and self-distillation targets detached
Code student-only contrast uses detached raw-affinity mask, forced positive diagonal, all-column denominator, temperature0.07 and factor0.5
All four pseudo detection classification/regression losses retained
Epoch-end EMA retention0.9; one-epoch final teacher is 0.9source+0.1finalStudent
explicit_port_differences: OBB/FPN pre-classifier D1024 instead of author ResNet ROI D2048
Shared HPL>=0.7 instead of official HPL>0.9
Shared one-epoch/batch32/LR0.02 versus author ten epochs/batch1/LR0.001, with per-image graph batching

canonical_mechanisms: Original indexed teacher proposals for feature pooling; decoded boxes only for rotated-IoU filtering

Empty HPL disables the auxiliary loss
IoU-to-HPL<=0.4, teacher background probability<=0.99, foreground-only softmax max>=0.9
Detached 1-cos weighting; code KL(teacher target||student) over C+1, not the reverse paper notation
Foreground teacher softmax plus background1e-10, weighted sum/kept count/10; no LPL boxes or LPL regression
All four HPL pseudo detection classification/regression losses retained

explicit_port_differences: Rotated pooling/decoding/IoU and source pre-classifier D1024

SF-UT.B_equivalence_verdict: distinct: SF-UT actively weights RPN and ROI pseudo regression, while actual B sets both to zero
SF-UT.canonical_choice: Explicit paper-defined SF-UT, not the README-selected source variant with weak-strong augmentation disabled and teacher update commented
SF-UT.paper_mechanisms: Teacher weak-view pseudo labels, strong Student, full RPN/ROI pseudo classification/regression, actual EMA after each optimizer step with retention0.9996
SF-UT.rejected_single_wq_alias: Alternate trainer generates pseudo labels from Student even though it maintains an evaluation EMA; this is not teacher-based SF-UT
explicit_port_differences: Shared OBB source architecture, image-only loader and common weak/strong transforms
Common HPL>=0.7 instead of original strict threshold>0.8
Shared one-epoch/global32/LR0.02 budget; no new graph, projection head or source retraining
SF-UT.separate_umbrella_strategy: AdaBN plus Fixed SF-FixMatch: target-only BN statistics pass, fixed pseudo labels, no EMA teacher updates; not B or SF-UT
